_comment: Optional per-tool wording for an annotation justification. Each entry names the hint value it was written for ("when"); the generator fails if the released server reports a different value or the tool no longer exists, so wording cannot drift from the real hints. Tools and hints not listed here use the generic wording in scripts/openai-plugin/build.py.

destructiveHint.text: Replaces the design the live blog shows; readers see the change at once.

openWorldHint.text: The change is visible on the public blog.

destructiveHint.text: Deletes every checkpoint newer than the target and, for the active design, changes the live blog.
Deletes older checkpoints irreversibly and, for the active design, publishes the saved version to the live blog.
Emails the newsletter to the consented list; a sent email cannot be recalled.

openWorldHint.text: Claims a public hostname for the blog; DNS-facing and visible on the internet.

destructiveHint.text: Sends each new recipient a consent-request email, which cannot be recalled.

openWorldHint.text: The consent request reaches external inboxes.

destructiveHint.text: Permanently deletes the post and, if it was published, its public page.
Permanently deletes recipients, their group memberships and their queued and historical emails.
Permanently deletes a saved template and the emails created from it.
Overwrites post fields (Markdown and tags are replaced wholesale); on a published post the public page changes.
Sends at once to consented recipients and sends consent requests to the rest; sends cannot be recalled.
Sends a saved template at once to consented recipients and consent requests to the rest; sends cannot be recalled.
Makes the post public and delivers it to the selected destinations (newsletter email, dev.to, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon); deliveries cannot be undone.

openWorldHint.text: Publishes to the public blog and to external email and social destinations.
Posts publicly on a third-party social network.

destructiveHint.text: Sends a built-in transactional email (account notice or receipt) immediately; it cannot be recalled.
Overwrites the post's destination selection and reviewed per-destination copy; nothing is sent.

openWorldHint.text: Stores the image at a public HTTPS URL.
